failures.criterion: A4 proof surface (rig check 13 `no-answer`): the check must pass on correct code. On this head it fails at random, because the rig reads the stored switch's delivery attempt before Dispatch has recorded it.
failures.evidence: Run A at head 87ea738e (`LEGION_TEST_PG_DSN='postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/postgres?sslmode=disable' SESSION_SETTINGS_EVIDENCE_DIR=$TMPDIR/infra195-test3/rig-evidence2 bash scripts/e2e/dispatch-session-settings.sh`): checks 1-12 ok, then `== no-answer / SIGSTOP Oh My Pi pid 38621 / FAIL no-answer: Dispatch's send failed: null`. `null` means `stored.message.deliveries.at(-1)` was undefined: the read held the message and no attempt. A failed attempt prints as an object. The failure screenshot (checks/15-no-answer-failed.png) shows the switch line "Switching model to anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5…" and the composer showing "Waiting for the session to answer the switch…". The page reaches that state only after the POST answered with an attempt that did not fail, so the delivery succeeded. Cause, from the code: Dispatch commits the message (packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/api/messages.go:189, tx.Commit) before `deliverMessage` asks the listener for the target and inserts the pending attempt (messages.go:193-198; message_delivery.go:618-631, resolveThenLock → recordPendingMessageDelivery). The rig's `newMessage` (scripts/e2e/lib/dispatch-session-settings.ts:671-682) returns at the first 250 ms poll that holds the message, and check 13 reads `deliveries.at(-1)` at once (:1592-1597). Run B on the same head passed check 13 (`ok no-answer (75s)`, `attempt 1 sent`), so the outcome depends on timing. Fix in this pull request, per the architect's standing ruling on defects in code the pull request touches: check 13 (or `newMessage`) waits until the message has a delivery attempt before it judges that attempt. No deterministic red test is committed: the race is inside the rig driver, which is itself the test and exports nothing a bun test could import, so the rig run above is the red evidence. Evidence: https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/2205#issuecomment-6406449541
